howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent 5-step roadmap. No complicated paperwork, no endless meetings.

howItWorks.step4Desc: We connect your custom business domain and publish your brand on the internet.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Google Search → Website → WhatsApp/Call → Real customer enquiries and walk-ins!

transparency.t5Desc: We do not claim 'guaranteed #1 Google ranking in 7 days'. We build solid, legitimate local business foundations.
transparency.y1Desc: Website + Domain + Hosting + Complete setup published live.
transparency.y2Desc: Standard domain & hosting renewal. Zero surprise setup fees.
transparency.y3Desc: Your website runs continuously, bringing recurring local inquiries.

faq.title: 5 Real Vendor Questions (Zero Confusion)
faq.subtitle: Straightforward, honest answers without corporate jargon:
faq.q1: 1. I don't know computer or English. How will I manage it?
faq.a1: You don't need to learn computer or English! You focus on your shop or clinic. LocalGrow manages all technical tasks including hosting, domain, setup, and updates on your behalf.
faq.q2: 2. Who will be the legal owner of the domain and website?
faq.a2: You! The domain is registered in your business name with your phone and email. We never lock or hold any business hostage. You retain 100% full legal ownership.
faq.q3: 3. Will there be unexpected hidden charges later?
faq.a3: Not a single rupee! First year domain and cloud hosting are fully included in the setup plan. Starting Year 2, only standard third-party renewal fees (~₹2,500 - ₹3,500/yr) apply, which are clearly disclosed upfront.
faq.q4: 4. What if my phone number, address, or prices change?
faq.a4: Simply send a quick WhatsApp photo or message to us. We update your live website within 24 to 48 hours without any hassle.
faq.q5: 5. Can I meet you face-to-face before deciding?
faq.a5: Yes, absolutely! If you are located in Mohali, Chandigarh, Panchkula (Tricity), or nearby areas, we can schedule an in-person meeting or live video walkthrough.
